basic_details.short_information: District Child Protection Unit Chengalpattu (DCPU Chengalpattu) is recruiting for 1 Outreach Worker vacancy on a purely temporary contract basis, with the last date to submit applications by hand or post being 28 October 2026. Applications must be sent to the District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, Room No. F0-06, Ground Floor, F-Block. Candidates can apply offline by downloading and filling the application form, and attaching copies of educational and other necessary certificates. faq.question: Q1. Is this Outreach Worker position permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The Outreach Worker position is filled on a purely temporary contract basis under the District Child Protection Unit.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Outreach Worker post is 42 years.

faq.question: Q3. What is the monthly salary for this post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated pay of Rs. 10,592/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. Where should candidates submit their filled application forms?
faq.answer: Filled applications must be submitted by post or in person to the District Child Protection Officer, District Child Protection Unit, Room No. F0-06, Ground Floor, F-Block, New District Collectorate Campus, Chengalpattu - 603 111.
